name: qemu-guests
description: Concurrent QEMU work guests with unattended provisioning and a shared Alpine Docker backend.

interface.shortDescription: Concurrent work VMs with a shared Alpine Docker backend.
interface.longDescription: Manages concurrent QEMU work guests alongside one persistent Alpine Docker backend on Windows and in Linux containers. Includes Ubuntu cloud-init, Windows answer files and Intel macOS Recovery automation using prepared Apple media and a bootstrap package. Work guests proxy Docker commands, API access and TCP publish ports to Alpine. The status panel lists work VMs and displays live read-only screens for graphical guests. Windows 11 hosts use a plugin-managed WHPX-only QEMU build for four-vCPU Windows guests and warm reboots.
defaultPrompt: Install an unattended Ubuntu work VM with the shared Alpine Docker backend.
Configure a custom unattended guest installation adapter.
